name: Sociedad Quimica y Minera de Chile S.A. (SQM)
sector: Materials / Specialty Chemicals & Mining — lithium, iodine, specialty plant nutrition
moat_justification: SQM's moat is a resource moat, not a pricing moat. FOR: the Salar de Atacama brine operation is structurally lower-cost than spodumene rivals, at world-leading lithium scale; SQM is also the world's leading iodine producer and a leader in potassium nitrate, which diversify earnings; resource access runs through the Corfo lease to 2030 and the Codelco/Nova Andino partnership into 2031-2060. AGAINST: SQM is a price-taker in lithium (revenue fell from $10.71B in FY2022 to $4.53B in FY2024 in the filed history), the core asset is state-owned and leased with rates up to 40% of the lithium price and a state majority partner from 2031, new supply from China/Africa/Argentina/Australia caused the last collapse, and capex is heavy ($971.8M in FY2024, ~US$3B guided for 2026-2028). Moderate moat, 5/10, CAP 8.5 years.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 21 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-22), cover page: 'Series B common shares, in the form of American Depositary Shares each representing one Series B share' registered on the NYSE; Glossary likewise defines ADR/ADS as 'each representing one series B common share'.) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:sbc — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-22), Note 17.6 Executive compensation plan: the share-based compensation plan 'was paid in cash in 2023' and its only stated income-statement expense is ThUS$2,251 for the year ended 2022; Item 16G NYSE-standards comparison states 'SQM does not have equity compensation plans' and that executives participate only in a long-term cash bonus compensation plan; Note 3.29 states compensation plans are share-based payments settled in cash, recognized at fair value through payroll. The other executive plan (Note 17.6 I) is explicitly paid in cash.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 1.7% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.3x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: World-scale low-cost lithium/iodine producer, moat 5/10 — but on the engine's stale trough median base ($1.06/share, history ending FY2024) it screens Tier D: weighted IRR 4.49%, weighted IV@15% $9.34 vs $60.75 per ADS; clears 15% only below ~$9.34 on this base, and the base — not the franchise — is the weak link (see analysis method-range note).
moat_for: Salar de Atacama brine resource: solar-evaporation brine extraction is structurally lower-cost than hard-rock spodumene, and SQM's scale there is world-leading in lithium
World-leading positions beyond lithium: the largest iodine producer and a leader in potassium nitrate / specialty plant nutrition, which earn through the lithium cycle
Long-dated resource access: Corfo lease to 2030 plus the Codelco partnership agreement (Nova Andino Litio) extending Salar operations into the 2031-2060 period

Diversified earnings base across lithium, iodine, specialty plant nutrition, potassium and industrial chemicals — OE was positive in 3 of the last 5 filed fiscal years despite the 2023-24 lithium collapse
Proven through-cycle cash generation: FY2022 conservative owner's earnings of $3,172,348,000 in the filed history show what the asset earns when lithium prices are strong
moat_against: Commodity price-taker: lithium is priced by the market, not by SQM — revenue swung from $10,710,578,000 (FY2022) to $4,528,761,000 (FY2024) in the filed history with no change in the asset base

The core asset is leased from the state: the Corfo Salar de Atacama lease expires December 31, 2030, lease rates already run up to 40% of the lithium price, and the Codelco partnership makes the Chilean state the majority productive actor for 2031-2060
Supply growth SQM does not control: Chinese, African and Argentine brine/spodumene and Australian restarts drove the 2023-24 price collapse and can repeat it
Atacama water use, community and environmental scrutiny, plus Chilean resource politics, cap how much of any price upside SQM keeps
Capex intensity is real and rising: capex was $971,792,000 in FY2024 against OCF of $1,274,678,000, and the company guides to about US$3 billion of capex over 2026-2028

overrides.source: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-22), Note 17.6 Executive compensation plan: the share-based compensation plan 'was paid in cash in 2023' and its only stated income-statement expense is ThUS$2,251 for the year ended 2022; Item 16G NYSE-standards comparison states 'SQM does not have equity compensation plans' and that executives participate only in a long-term cash bonus compensation plan; Note 3.29 states compensation plans are share-based payments settled in cash, recognized at fair value through payroll. The other executive plan (Note 17.6 I) is explicitly paid in cash.
